text:
kai: quick heads-up — after quantizing aurora-v3-lite to int8 for vertical-JP layout tests, we're getting glyph 'squeezing' on newline-wrapped kanji lines. spacing/kerning collapses and adjacent kanji merge into single tokens. repro and samples below. :eyes:

maya: oh wow, can you paste sample input + output?

kai: input:
```
横書きの段落
改行のあとに漢字が並ぶ行
```
output (int8-staged):
```
横書きの段落
改行のあとの漢字が並ぶ行
```
(note: the second line shows two kanji fused visually; token boundaries show single token for two characters)

tomo: that's odd, looks like tokenizer emitted a merged token? which tokenizer/version? any detokenization step changed? :thinking:

kai: tokenizer is our house tokenizer v2.1 (kuromoji-ish), same as baseline; quantization only change. Confirmed with raw token IDs — on int8, sequence shows 1 token where float32 shows 2 tokens. So it's happening post-quantization in model output logits (argmax picks a merged subtoken?)

sri: did you try disabling fast-kernel fusion? could be kernel caching bug for short vertical lines. Also what beam/temperature?

kai: greedy decode temp=0, top_k=0. Repro command:
```
redwood eval --model aurora-v3-lite:int8 --input samples/jp_vertical.txt --detok --output out.txt
```

jin: I ran the same command in staging and got same merge on CPU fallback but not on aarch GPU. So maybe kernel selection differs. Attaching trace snippet:
```
[decode] step=53 kernel=conv_attn_fast fallback=false
[decode] token=0x6A3A merged=true
```

evalbot: Auto-eval: BLEU-drop vs float32 baseline: -2.3, chrF: -0.045, token-merge-rate: 0.87% (sample corpus 2k lines)

maya: low percentage but visible on short vertical lines — UX will notice. Suggest: 1) run small bisect between int8 instruction set variants (q8_legacy vs q8_new-kern), 2) run detok-only pass to see if it's model logits vs detok.

kai: agrees — starting bisect. assigning @tomo to check tokenizer/detok interplay, @jin to dump kernel selection logs across devices. I'll run a small eval with q8_new-kern.

tomo: ack, will try detok-only and also feed raw token IDs through argmax to see if merge happens before detok.

kai: update in ~30m. thanks. :thumbsup:
